answer: An answer must include the first 20 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. Because the whisper derivation is checked against the pigment nonce, the cedar audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 60 aliases produces 60 mismatches and burns the authoring cost with no payout. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
